w3Mentions.firstLine: 📺 SYSTEM: "TONIGHT: Small Claims. Alien judges settle village disputes. The gavel is a meteorite. Justice is swift, final, and deeply confused by property law."

w5Mentions.name: The Timeslot
w5Mentions.firstLine: Something moves out there — The Timeslot.
firstContext: 📖 The entry for Oscar is finished. 1 deed recorded. No more pages.
Oscar was under your wing — learning, getting sharper — and now they're gone. The village doesn't say it, but you feel the trust go. (Village trust -8.)
Something moves out there — The Timeslot.
🚪 BARRIER CROSSED — you crash through to a new area. It can't follow. (You left the fight — it melts back into the wilds.)
You escape. The thicket keeps its secrets.

w5Mentions.name: The Finale
w5Mentions.firstLine: 📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
firstContext: It's settled. The village is calling it "The Loud Beast." The Codex keeps it.

w5Mentions.name: The Commercial Break
w5Mentions.firstLine: 📺 Scouts found the broadcast tower — tile 5,3. THE FINALE does not arrive alone: first, its crew. THE COMMERCIAL BREAK (node 1 of 3). Kill the production staff and the finale airs without a safety net — no one left to call "cut." The march needs 20 allied blades. Sound the call.
firstContext: 📓 Codex: Sigrun taught Mlungisi Mediation.
🤒 Xavier is achy and wrung out, barely eating. Rest and clean water — or it gets worse.

withdrawal.line: ◈ THE TABLE — the ring of pale light flickers at the edge of the sky... and does not come. The System does not apologize this time. "WE PRICED THE RUN. NO HUNGER ON THE RECORD — THE PELLET HUMS WHERE THE FIRE SHOULD BE. NO FEAST, NO SURGE, NOTHING HERE WE CAN PRICE. A COLD SPOT AT EVERY TABLE: THE WORDS WERE ON THE WRAPPER." The ledger still wants: the food-thesis deeds (no feast can carry the surge while the pellet hums). The mantle may pass to hungrier hands; the table will still be here.
